videos.title: Jaaji Enters Ayyana Mane
videos.overview: Jaaji arrives at her marital home on her wedding day, only to witness her father-in-law's sudden death. As she discovers more chilling secrets, Jaaji must find a way to survive in the house.

videos.title: Whispers From The Well
videos.overview: Jaaji learns more shocking facts as the mystery behind Pushpavathi’s death is revealed. Jaaji must now decide between leaving the house and uncovering the truth behind these deaths.

videos.title: The Woman Before Me
videos.overview: Jaaji is shocked to learn about Dushyantha’s past. Doubt and fear creep in as she realises that her own family deceived her into this marriage despite knowing about the family’s dark past.

videos.title: Blood Money
videos.overview: Jaaji discovers that her husband received insurance money after his first wife’s death. Another death occurs in the family. Desperate to know the truth, Jaaji turns to her friend in the police force.

videos.title: The Root Cause
videos.overview: The police investigation enrages the family. The death reports turn Tayavva into a suspect. Was Tayavva the one who knew the dark secret behind the incidents that haunt the family?

videos.title: I'm The Princess
videos.overview: The family visits the Kondayya temple to seek blessings and restore peace as Jaaji and Nagalambike confront each other back home. Will the deadly curse that claimed six lives finally be over?

videos.title: Karna Pichachi
videos.overview: Bad omens spread fear, doubts deepen, and a divided family struggles to face an unsettling truth.

videos.title: Good News
videos.overview: A joyous wedding lights up Ayyana Mane, but a Deepavali tragedy leaves the family shattered.

videos.title: Is Kondayya Angry?
videos.overview: With the protector gone, Jaaji struggles with grief. Kondayya fails to shield Ayyana Mane.

videos.title: The Big Clue
videos.overview: Old wounds resurface as a baby goes missing, but a wedding card changes everything.

videos.title: The Final Showdown
videos.overview: The handwriting expert is proven right as Kondayya’s arrival reveals the truth.
